# Backend Deployment Guide

This guide covers deploying the RConsoleAI secure gateway to Cloudflare Workers.

## Why Deploy a Backend?

The backend gateway enables:
- **NVIDIA Nemotron** models (requires API key)
- **OpenAI-compatible** endpoints (OpenAI, Azure, local models)
- **Rate limiting** and abuse prevention
- **Credential isolation** - API keys never leave Cloudflare
- **Custom provider configurations**

## Prerequisites

1. **Cloudflare Account** - Free tier at [cloudflare.com](https://cloudflare.com)
2. **Node.js 18+** and npm
3. **Wrangler CLI** - `npm install -g wrangler`
4. **API Keys** for desired providers:
   - NVIDIA: Get from [build.nvidia.com](https://build.nvidia.com/)
   - OpenAI: Get from [platform.openai.com](https://platform.openai.com/)

## Quick Deploy

```bash
# 1. Clone and enter backend directory
cd backend

# 2. Install dependencies
npm install

# 3. Login to Cloudflare
npx wrangler login

# 4. Set secrets (choose providers you want)
npx wrangler secret put NVIDIA_API_KEY
# Enter your NVIDIA API key when prompted

npx wrangler secret put OPENAI_API_KEY
# Enter your OpenAI API key when prompted

# Optional: Custom OpenAI endpoint (Azure, local, etc.)
npx wrangler secret put OPENAI_BASE_URL
# Enter: https://api.openai.com/v1 (or your endpoint)

# 5. Deploy
npx wrangler deploy

# 6. Note the deployed URL (e.g., https://rconsoleai-gateway.your-subdomain.workers.dev)
```

## Configuration Options

### Environment Variables (wrangler.toml)

```toml
[vars]
ENVIRONMENT = "production"
LOG_LEVEL = "info"

# Rate limits (per IP)
# RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE = "60"
# RATE_LIMIT_PER_HOUR = "1000"

# CORS - restrict to your domains
# ALLOWED_ORIGINS = "https://yourdomain.com,http://localhost:8080"
```

### Secrets (set via `wrangler secret put`)

| Secret | Required | Description |
|--------|----------|-------------|
| `NVIDIA_API_KEY` | For NVIDIA | NVIDIA API key from build.nvidia.com |
| `OPENAI_API_KEY` | For OpenAI-compatible | OpenAI or compatible API key |
| `OPENAI_BASE_URL` | Optional | Custom endpoint (default: api.openai.com/v1) |
| `OPENAI_ORGANIZATION` | Optional | OpenAI organization ID |
| `RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE` | Optional | Per-IP per-minute limit (default: 60) |
| `RATE_LIMIT_PER_HOUR` | Optional | Per-IP per-hour limit (default: 1000) |
| `ALLOWED_ORIGINS` | Optional | Comma-separated allowed origins for CORS |

## Local Development

```bash
cd backend
npm install
npm run dev
```

This starts a local development server at `http://localhost:8787`.

Test locally:
```bash
# Health check
curl http://localhost:8787/health

# List models
curl http://localhost:8787/models

# Chat
curl -X POST http://localhost:8787/chat \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Hello"}]}'
```

## Configure R Package

Once deployed, configure RConsoleAI:

```r
library(rconsoleai)

# Set your gateway URL
rchat_config(gateway_url = "https://your-worker.your-subdomain.workers.dev")

# Use gateway provider
rchat_provider("gateway")

# Or use auto (tries gateway first)
rchat_provider("auto")

# Test
rchat("Hello from RConsoleAI with gateway!")
```

## Verifying Deployment

### Check Health
```bash
curl https://your-worker.your-subdomain.workers.dev/health
```

Should return:
```json
{
  "status": "ok",
  "service": "rconsoleai-gateway",
  "version": "0.1.0",
  "timestamp": "2024-..."
}
```

### Check Models
```bash
curl https://your-worker.your-subdomain.workers.dev/models
```

Should list available models from configured providers.

### Check Providers
```bash
curl https://your-worker.your-subdomain.workers.dev/providers
```

Shows which providers are configured.

## Monitoring

### Logs
```bash
npx wrangler tail
```

### Metrics
View in Cloudflare Dashboard > Workers > your-worker > Metrics

### Errors
Check Cloudflare Dashboard > Workers > your-worker > Logs

## Updating Secrets

```bash
npx wrangler secret put NVIDIA_API_KEY
# Enter new key

npx wrangler deploy
```

## Production Considerations

### Custom Domain
1. Cloudflare Dashboard > Workers > your-worker > Triggers
2. Add Custom Domain
3. Update `rchat_config(gateway_url = "https://ai.yourdomain.com")`

### KV for Rate Limiting (Advanced)
For multi-instance rate limiting, uncomment in wrangler.toml:
```toml
[[kv_namespaces]]
binding = "RATE_LIMIT_KV"
id = "your-kv-namespace-id"
```

### Durable Objects (Advanced)
For more sophisticated rate limiting:
```toml
[[durable_objects.bindings]]
name = "RATE_LIMITER"
class_name = "RateLimiter"
```

## Troubleshooting

### "Worker not found"
- Verify deployment: `npx wrangler deploy`
- Check subdomain in Cloudflare Dashboard

### "Secrets not found"
- Verify: `npx wrangler secret list`
- Re-add if missing

### "CORS error"
- Set `ALLOWED_ORIGINS` secret
- Or use `*` for development only

### "Rate limited"
- Check limits in wrangler.toml
- Increase `RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE`/`PER_HOUR`

### "Model not available"
- Verify provider API key has access to model
- Check provider status page
- Run `/models` in R to see available

## Security Notes

- **Never commit secrets** to git
- **Use `wrangler secret put`** for all credentials
- **Restrict CORS** to known domains in production
- **Monitor usage** in Cloudflare Dashboard
- **Rotate keys periodically**

## Cost Estimation

Cloudflare Workers Free Tier:
- 100,000 requests/day
- 10ms CPU time/request
- Sufficient for personal/small team use

Paid plans start at $5/month for higher limits.
